events.title: Storming of the Bastille
events.descr: Parisians take the royal fortress-prison on 14 July: the Revolution reaches the streets.

events.title: French monarchy abolished
events.descr: The National Convention abolishes the monarchy on 21 September 1792 and proclaims the Republic.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_start: Abolition of the French monarchy, 21 September 1792

events.title: Hundred Days
events.descr: Napoleon returns from Elba and rules again until Waterloo; months long, so shown as an event until dates can carry months.

events.title: July Revolution
events.descr: Charles X is overthrown; Louis Philippe becomes King of the French.

events.title: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire
events.descr: Francis II lays down the imperial crown on 6 August 1806.

events.title: German Confederation founded
events.descr: The Congress of Vienna creates a league of 39 German states.

events.title: German revolutions of 1848–49
events.descr: The Frankfurt Parliament tries to unite Germany under a constitution and fails.

events.title: Austro-Prussian War
events.descr: Prussia defeats Austria; the Peace of Prague dissolves the German Confederation.

events.title: German Empire proclaimed
events.descr: Wilhelm I is proclaimed German Emperor at Versailles on 18 January 1871.

events.title: German Revolution
events.descr: Wilhelm II abdicates; a republic is proclaimed and the German monarchies fall.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Abdication of Wilhelm II and republic proclaimed, 9 November 1918

events.title: Berlin Wall
events.descr: Built from 13 August 1961; opened on 9 November 1989.

events.title: Serbian Revolution
events.descr: Uprisings against Ottoman rule that end in an autonomous Principality of Serbia.

events.title: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes created
events.descr: Serbia and the South Slav lands of Austria-Hungary unite on 1 December 1918.

events.title: Axis invasion of Yugoslavia
events.descr: Germany, Italy and Hungary invade on 6 April 1941; the country is partitioned.

events.title: Yugoslav Wars
events.descr: Wars of independence and ethnic conflict as Yugoslavia breaks up.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event9: Start of the Yugoslav Wars, 27 June 1991

events.title: Federal Republic of Yugoslavia proclaimed
events.descr: Serbia and Montenegro form a new federation on 27 April 1992; the socialist federation is gone.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Disintegrated (FR Yugoslavia is proclaimed by Serbia and Montenegro), 27 April 1992

events.title: Montenegro independent; the State Union ends
events.descr: Montenegro leaves on 3 June 2006; Serbia declares itself the successor on 5 June.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Independence of Serbia, 5 June 2006

events.title: First Battle of Panipat
events.descr: Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi, the last Sultan of Delhi, and founds the Mughal Empire.

events.title: Battle of Plassey
events.descr: The East India Company defeats the Nawab of Bengal; Company rule in India begins.

events.title: Indian Rebellion of 1857
events.descr: A rising against Company rule ends the Mughal Empire and the Company's rule; the Crown governs India directly.

events.title: Independence and partition of India
events.descr: British India is partitioned into the dominions of India and Pakistan on 14–15 August 1947.

events.title: India becomes a republic
events.descr: The constitution takes effect on 26 January 1950.

events.title: Fall of Tenochtitlan
events.descr: Cortés and his Indigenous allies take the Aztec capital; New Spain is founded on its site.

events.title: Mexican War of Independence
events.descr: From Hidalgo's call to arms in 1810 to the entry into Mexico City in 1821; the viceroyalty ends.

events.title: Mexican–American War
events.descr: Mexico loses about half its territory to the United States.

events.title: Second French intervention in Mexico
events.descr: France installs Maximilian as emperor; the republic under Juárez wins and he is executed in 1867.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox date: 8 December 1861Spain and UK as belligerents – 21 June 1867

events.title: Mexican Revolution
events.descr: Díaz is overthrown; a decade of civil war ends with the 1917 constitution and the revolutionary state.

events.title: Constitution of 1917
events.descr: The current constitution, adopted on 5 February 1917.

events.title: Dutch East India Company founded
events.descr: The States General merges the Dutch trading companies into the VOC.

events.title: Proclamation of Indonesian Independence
events.descr: Sukarno and Hatta declare independence two days after Japan's surrender.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event7: Proclamation of Indonesian Independence, 17 August 1945

events.title: Dutch recognise Indonesian sovereignty
events.descr: Sovereignty passes to the federal United States of Indonesia on 27 December 1949.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_start: Independence from the Netherlands, 27 December 1949

events.title: Unitary Republic of Indonesia
events.descr: The federation is dissolved into the unitary Republic on 17 August 1950.

sources.sourceLocation: infobox event_end: Replaced by the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia, 17 August 1950

events.title: Lagos becomes a British colony
events.descr: Annexed in 1861, Lagos is declared a colony on 5 March 1862.

events.title: Amalgamation of Nigeria
events.descr: The Northern and Southern protectorates are joined on 1 January 1914.

events.title: Nigerian independence
events.descr: Nigeria becomes independent on 1 October 1960.

events.title: January 1966 coup
events.descr: The First Republic falls to a military coup on 15 January 1966.

events.title: Nigerian Civil War
events.descr: The Eastern Region secedes as the Republic of Biafra and is defeated in January 1970.

events.title: Fourth Republic
events.descr: Civilian rule returns under the 1999 constitution.

events.title: Acts of Union (England and Scotland)
events.descr: England and Scotland unite as the Kingdom of Great Britain on 1 May 1707.

events.title: Acts of Union (Great Britain and Ireland)
events.descr: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland begins on 1 January 1801.

events.title: Irish Free State established
events.descr: Most of Ireland leaves the United Kingdom on 6 December 1922; Northern Ireland stays.

events.title: Swedish War of Liberation
events.descr: Gustav Vasa leads Sweden out of the Kalmar Union; he is elected king in 1523.

events.title: Treaty of Kiel
events.descr: Denmark cedes Norway to Sweden on 14 January 1814; Norway declares independence and is forced into union with Sweden.

events.title: Union of Sweden and Norway dissolved
Finland declares independence
events.descr: Finland declares independence from Russia on 6 December 1917.

events.title: Union of Lublin
events.descr: Poland and Lithuania form a single Commonwealth on 1 July 1569.

sources.sourceLocation: lead: "The Union of Lublin established the Commonwealth as a single entity on 1 July 1569."

events.title: Third Partition of Poland
events.descr: Russia, Prussia and Austria divide what is left of the Commonwealth.

events.title: Austro-Hungarian Compromise
events.descr: The empire becomes the Dual Monarchy of Austria-Hungary; Transylvania is joined to Hungary.

events.title: Dissolution of Austria-Hungary
events.descr: Defeat in the First World War breaks the monarchy into successor states.

events.title: Act of Abjuration
events.descr: The northern provinces renounce Philip II; the south stays with Spain.

events.title: Treaty of Rastatt
events.descr: The Spanish Netherlands pass to the Austrian Habsburgs.

events.title: Anschluss
events.descr: Nazi Germany annexes Austria in March 1938.

events.title: Austrian State Treaty
events.descr: The occupying powers leave; Austria is independent and neutral.

events.title: War of the Spanish Succession
events.descr: The Bourbons win the Spanish throne; the Nueva Planta decrees abolish the Crown of Aragon.

events.title: 5 October 1910 revolution
events.descr: The Portuguese monarchy is overthrown.

events.title: Treaty of Campo Formio
events.descr: France and Austria end the Venetian Republic.

events.title: Kingdom of the Two Sicilies established
Treaty of Berlin
events.descr: The powers recognise Serbia, Montenegro and Romania; Bulgaria becomes an autonomous principality; Austria-Hungary occupies Bosnia.

events.title: Ten-Day War
events.descr: Slovenia secures its independence from Yugoslavia.

events.title: Kosovo declares independence
events.descr: Serbia and many other states do not recognise it.

events.title: Battle of Mohács
events.descr: The Ottomans destroy the Hungarian army; the kingdom splits between Habsburg and Ottoman-backed kings.

events.title: Treaty of Karlowitz
events.descr: The Ottomans cede most of Hungary to the Habsburgs.

events.title: Thirty Years' War
events.descr: Begins with the Bohemian revolt in Prague; ends with the Peace of Westphalia.

events.title: Great Northern War
events.descr: Sweden loses its Baltic empire.

events.title: German occupation of Czechoslovakia
events.descr: Slovakia declares independence on 14 March 1939; Germany occupies the Czech lands the next day.

events.title: Invasion of Poland
events.descr: Germany and then the Soviet Union invade; the Second World War begins.

events.title: Revolutions of 1989
events.descr: Communist rule ends across Central and Eastern Europe.

events.title: Dissolution of Czechoslovakia
events.descr: Czechoslovakia splits peacefully into the Czech Republic and Slovakia on 1 January 1993.

events.title: Union of Moldavia and Wallachia
events.descr: Both principalities elect Alexandru Ioan Cuza as prince in 1859.
